headline: Barracuda flaws now exploited in attacks with KEV deadline 11-13; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12; Vanderbilt on ransomware lockdown

bullets.text: Changed: SecurityWeek reports the recently patched Barracuda flaws are being exploited in attacks (4 outlets). CISA lists Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) in KEV, due 11-13.
Due 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 (exploited despite patches), Chrome's eighth exploited zero-day CVE-2026-125350 and Outlook CVE-2026-124194. Leaked exploit kits are hitting iPhones via an Instagram ad; no CVE named.

Still active: N-able keeps hosted N-central offline after dozens of published zero-days; SAP patched four CVSS 10.0 flaws (ICM2SHELL); AhsayCBS CVE-2026-105133/105134 and a Xen Orchestra auth bypass are exploited.

Ransomware and breaches: Vanderbilt is on lockdown after a BYOD-claimed attack (6 outlets); Kinnarps stopped production at three sites; YouHack's 7,160,849 accounts added to Have I Been Pwned; Nitori says 37.6M customer records stolen.

AI and cloud supply chain: Fireworks AI breach widened to datasets, model weights and Notion AI chats; SGLang RCE breached NEAR AI; trusted AWS access abused across clouds. 300 malicious packages in 7 days, mostly npm; the week ran 1.11x the 90-day average.

actions: Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 now (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise, since exploitation is confirmed.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop (CVE-2026-20320, CVE-2026-111793) and update Chrome and Outlook fleet-wide.
Apply SAP's November patches for the four CVSS 10.0 flaws, and patch or isolate AhsayCBS and Xen Orchestra servers.
N-central customers: follow N-able's guidance while the hosted service is offline and review remote-access logs.
If you use Fireworks AI or Qubole, rotate API keys; review AWS cross-account trust and AssumeRole activity.
